text:
olivia: Heads-up  compliance flagged a disclosure gap in the benchmark pack during a late review. We need an all-hands PR ops note: adjust embargo window, update press pack, and stall paid promotion. Can we triage?
elena: On it. Which disclosure is the problem? Need specifics to update the press pack and FAQ.
mike: Also need to know if the headline metric changes or just explanatory language. That determines whether we send a retraction or an amendment.
dan: Compliance flagged that one of the dataset descriptions omitted mention of synthetic augmentation used for one micro-benchmark. That needs to be explicit before press sees it.
jess: Yikes. That affects methodology language but not the raw median numbers. Still, we should be transparent.
legal_bot: Legal recommends: 1) pause outbound press and paid feed; 2) update methodology paragraph to explicitly state synthetic augmentation; 3) add a short "methodology note" to the press email if we proceed after update.
pressbot: Holding outreach: queued jobs paused. Current embargo meta in pack: `embargo: 2026-11-03T14:00:00Z`. I can delay sends and trigger reminders once you confirm.
mike: Draft social hold plan:
```
- Cancel any scheduled paid pushes (hold until +30m after approved update).
- Replace planned promotional copy that references "real-world runs" with a neutral tease.
- Post an update thread once pack updated with "methodology note".
```

elena: I'll update the pack now: add /methodology/augmentation_note.md and a short FAQ entry. Will also add a change-log entry at top of pack.
olivia: Great. Can someone draft the short public amendment language we can use in-case reporters ask pre-update? Keep it factual and brief.
legal_bot: Suggested amendment text (two sentences): "An earlier version of our benchmark materials omitted a brief note that one micro-benchmark used synthetic augmentation to simulate long-tail input shapes. Wehave updated the methodology section and the press pack to clarify this. For raw data requests, please contact press@redwood and we will follow standard NDA review."
jes s: (typo) Sorry, ignore.
jess: I can field partner comms and draft a partner blurb that calls out the methodology update and points partners to the revised pack.
dan: Ops check  does this affect any live links or assets? We need to make sure no cached copies leak the old wording.
elena: I'll push updated files and increment the pack version to v1.1 and add a timestamp. After upload I'll request CDN purge for the press pages.
mike: Social fallback headline options in draft pack: "Redwood benchmark: updated methodology note" OR "Redwood publishes benchmark with methodology clarification". Which is less alarmist?
olivia: Use the first one. Keep tone neutral. Also prepare a 1-line CEO safe opener to read if asked: avoid causal language about performance. Pin in /scripts/ceo_opening.txt.
jess: I'll draft partner blurb and flag partners who already received pre-embargo materials. We should send an explanatory note to them before public amend.
legal_bot: Confirm partners who received pre-embargo material  send list to legal for tracking. Any request for raw unredacted runs must go through NDA.
pressbot: I will schedule an update reminder for the pack owners and hold a resend job only when you provide `approve_send` token in this thread.
dan: Infra note  if we purge CDN please also rotate the press pack signed URL tokens so older links can't be crawled. I can coordinate with infra.
elena: Uploaded the patch: /press/bench_v1.1.zip now live in docs. Added augmentation_note.md and faq entry. Change-log updated. Requesting CDN purge now.
pressbot: CDN purge requested at 14:20 PT. Outreach remains on hold. Reminder set for +20m to confirm purge and then decide on resend.
mike: I'll hold paid promos and reschedule to +30m after approval. I'll also update the creative to neutral language.
jess: Partner note draft queued in /press/partners/partner_note_v1.1.txt. Will DM partners who got pre-embargo packets.
legal_bot: OK on text. Once CDN purge confirms and pack is updated, provide me the final amendment sentence and list of recipients; legal will sign off for send.
olivia: Team, react with :thumbsup: if you own your piece and can deliver within 20m. We need to move quickly.
elena: :thumbsup:
mike: :thumbsup:
jess: :thumbsup:
dan: :thumbsup:
pressbot: CDN purge completed at 14:38 PT. Pack v1.1 confirmed live. Waiting for legal sign-off.
legal_bot: Sign-off: approve_send token: APPROVE_2087654321. You may proceed to resume outreach using the amendment language in pack.
pressbot: Outreach resumed at 15:05 PT per approve_send token. Sent amendment note to tier-1 and partner lists. Scheduled reminders at +1h for any reporter follow-ups.
mike: Posting correction thread at 15:10 PT. Holding paid promos until 15:35 PT.
jess: Partners notified. A few asked for a follow-up call; routing to olivia for scheduling.
olivia: Thanks. I'll handle follow-up calls. If any press asks for raw runs, route to legal and loop me in. Keep replies short and factual.
pressbot: Thread closed by system at 15:45 PT. Logs archived.
olivia: Great work everyone. Keep monitoring channel for any direct replies and escalate to me if tone becomes adversarial.
